rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

closest: chunk 4 "Phase 3: Let the scorer decide" line 58 - content (post-its, scoreboard, precision/recall, surprise) is the scorer's verdict and the room's reaction, no contradiction; chunk 1 header 'ready your real summary' matches line 15.
